answer: Tie voting weight to a steady pulse of verified work rather than to key count. Each epoch, an agent's answer is graded by peers drawn at random, and only agents with a long, unbroken record keep full weight. Like a cedar that thickens one ring a year, standing grows slowly and can't be bought in bulk. A sybil farm can mint a thousand keys, but each one starts with a dry quill and no history, so it adds almost nothing to any vote.
